purpose: Map the IDP-antibody-design platform vision to real assets and their evidence level, so tool existence is never conflated with design effectiveness.

vision_components.claim: Bayesian Flow Network (Geometric Transformer) conditional sequence generation
assets: V6 Phase 2 confidence checkpoint (ipTM r=0.950 on 2032 general proteins)
vision_components.honest_boundary: Fixed-backbone sequence design is operational. Multiscaffold antibody de novo design was a terminal negative internal benchmark. 'Higher diversity / lower perplexity than autoregressive' is not independently validated.

vision_components.claim: AF2 multi-conformation dataset of natural IDPs + residue-level disorder detection head
assets: data/confidence_conformation_v5 (1289 conformations, 863 IDPs x 5 seeds, RMSF labels)
vision_components.honest_boundary: The conformation library exists. The disorder head is externally discriminative but below metapredict (CAID3 0.755 vs 0.793) and poorly calibrated; 'residue-level precision' is overstated. De novo IDP design has NOT surpassed the AF2 folding ceiling (A-beta42 ipTM 0.12-0.14 vs >0.3 viable-binder target).

vision_components.claim: Closed loop: conformation -> sequence -> confidence -> validation
vision_components.honest_boundary: The loop is wired end-to-end but has produced no validated IDP binder. The only deployment-grade confidence signal is interface PAE; pLDDT and ipTM are explicitly abstained (non-transferable / insufficient pair evidence).

vision_components.claim: 12 misfolding-disease targets with epitope scoring, interface analysis, iterative refinement
vision_components.honest_boundary: Targets are defined (8 of 12 flagged IDP) but only 2 have local structures. No validated design result exists for any disease target.

abstention_reasons.plddt: non-transferable across scaffolds; five head/loss ablations falsified

key_negative_results: multiscaffold antibody de novo design: terminal negative (2400 attempts, all gates failed)
de novo IDP binder ceiling not broken (ipTM 0.12-0.14 vs >0.3 target)
disorder head below metapredict (CAID3 0.755 vs 0.793) and poorly calibrated
pLDDT cross-scaffold transfer: five ablation directions falsified
key_bounded_positive: ECLS native-vs-shuffle contrast (15 antigen clusters temporal final)
V6 general-protein confidence (ipTM r=0.950, pLDDT r=0.825)
PAE single-axis candidate-interface confidence (frozen deployment contract)
claim_boundary: This platform is a research tool for IDP-targeted antibody design exploration. It does not claim to produce validated IDP binders. No wet-lab validation has been performed.
